project_type: Flutter + Riverpod local-first personal-finance app (SQLite via sqflite). UI under lib/presentation/ (MVVM-ish: StateNotifier/FutureProvider providers + ConsumerWidget screens + shared widgets). Data under lib/data (models + repositories), services under lib/services.
build_system: Flutter / pub. No codegen in play for these files (JSON is hand-written toMap/fromMap/fromJson). flutter_lints ^5.0.0 is the lint ruleset.
test_framework: package:flutter_test. Tests live in test/ mirroring lib/, files end _test.dart. DB-backed tests use sqflite_common_ffi (already a dependency). Existing unit tests under test/unit/ (e.g. transaction_calculation_test.dart is a pure-model example to mirror).
verification_instructions: After each change: run `flutter analyze` (no new errors) and `flutter test` (all existing ~103 tests + any new tests green). Prefer adding PURE helper functions for new logic and unit-testing those without a DB. For a single new test file: `flutter test test/unit/<file>_test.dart`.
environment_constraints: Work on the already-checked-out branch redesign/mykhata-2.0 (HEAD d78d508). Do NOT create a worktree or new branch. Do NOT push. Commit locally only. Windows + pwsh shell.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md present. Repo skill guides (read and follow): .agents/skills/flutter-apply-architecture-best-practices (composition/business logic lives in the provider/data layer, widgets stay dumb and just read state), dart-add-unit-test (mirror lib/ in test/, _test.dart suffix, group/test/expect), dart-run-static-analysis (flutter analyze; dart fix --apply for mechanical lints), flutter-implement-json-serialization (manual fromMap/toMap pattern already used by models). FORMATTING: committed Dart is NOT dart-format-clean and the editor reflows on save; run `dart format <changed files>` and ACCEPT the reflow — do not fight it or treat reflow diffs as regressions.
key_patterns: Shared widgets in lib/presentation/widgets: AppCard (+CardElevation), ListRowTile/SettingsGroup/ManagementScaffold (list_widgets.dart), showFieldsSheet/AppBottomSheet.show/confirmDestructive (app_sheets.dart), IconSquareButton (icon_square_button.dart — EXISTS, findings report saying it's missing is stale), SegmentedTabs, PillChips, AppDropdown, PrimaryButton, AnimatedProgressBar(+budgetProgressColor), AsyncSection, FadeSlideIn, SectionHeader. Design tokens: AppSpacing (xs4/sm8/md12/lg16/xl24/xxl32), AppRadius, AppText, AppPalette via context.palette, AppMotion, AppHaptics. Providers keep no-flicker reloads via `if (!state.hasValue) state = loading` and `.when(skipLoadingOnReload: true)`. Phase-3 calm: no new gradients/heavy shadows, single edge signal on cards.
